summary: Skratch pulled 300 summons on the Thunderbolt Selectable Banner to acquire Tariz, aiming to strengthen AoE damage for Magichess Strategy Challenges and upcoming Continental Challenge bosses. He notes that Thunderbolt AoE damage dealers like Tariz, Perkunte, and Alaura excel in multi-target endgame content. Free-to-play and low-spending players are strongly advised to hold their Heliolite Dice for the upcoming Anniversary and Child of Chaos banners. Furthermore, he shares shop strategies for Temporal Corridor, prioritizing support duplicate inspirations like Maashtur over damage dealers.

meta_changes: Upcoming Continental Challenge bosses heavily favor AoE damage compositions over single-target damage.
Anniversary updates will bring the limited Child of Chaos banner and a 12-Schools of Damage selector banner.
tips: Free-to-play and low-spending players should save summons for the Anniversary and potential limited Child of Chaos banner.
Avoid buying damage dealers from the Lingering Echo store in Temporal Corridor; prioritize high-impact support duplicates such as Maashtur.
Save Myriad Stars for key Toxin heroes like Slay when they appear in the Temporal Corridor shop rotation.
title: CHANGE OF PLANS! I Pulled For Tariz... Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
